## Results

- A 30-minute workshop that takes math faculty with no web experience to a deployed Streamlit app
- Three-part structure with guided, intermediate and challenge variants of each lab
- Authored and maintained in the department org repository

## The problem

Instructors want interactive teaching tools but lack web-development skills.

## What I built

I wrote an instructor-led walkthrough of a reference app in five steps, then tiered lab shells (guided, statistics dashboard, open challenge), deployment to Streamlit Cloud, and a quick-reference sheet.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## What it is for

Builds analytic capacity in others: colleagues leave able to field their own tools.
:::

## Tools

Python, Streamlit, numpy, pandas, matplotlib
